purpose: Declares the tasks that 3webs can perform and the Machine Web / A2A intent vocabulary that 3webs can observe, classify and evaluate on public machine-facing interfaces.

interpretation.statement: A declared intent describes a requested or advertised machine action. Its presence does not by itself prove that the corresponding capability is reachable, invocable or operational.

service_intents.name: Observe a domain once
service_intents.description: Perform a point-in-time observation of publicly accessible evidence for a domain.
utterances: how visible is this domain to AI
what do AI systems see on this site
what does a crawler see on this website
check the human web, AI web and machine web for this domain

output.description: Point-in-time evidence and signal results for the submitted public domain.

service_intents.name: Observe a domain continuously
service_intents.description: Re-observe a public domain over time and detect material changes in observable signals.
utterances: tell me when my score drops
monitor the human web, AI web and machine web

output.description: A sequence of observations and detected changes over time.

service_intents.name: Compare two observations
service_intents.description: Compare a current observation with an identified baseline observation and report the observable delta.
utterances: what changed since my last observation
show the delta since last month

output.description: Signal-level differences between the baseline and current observation.

service_intents.name: Explain a signal result
service_intents.description: Return the observable evidence and evaluation rationale for a specific signal.
utterances: show me the evidence for this signal

output.description: Signal state, test method, observable evidence and explanation.

service_intents.name: List the signal catalogue
service_intents.description: Return the current 3webs observation signal catalogue and associated metadata.
utterances: which SEO AEO GEO AIO and AI signals do you measure

output.description: Current signal definitions and available methodological metadata.

machine_web_intent_vocabulary.purpose: Machine Web and A2A intent vocabulary used by 3webs to identify, classify and describe agent capabilities observed on public machine-facing interfaces.
machine_web_intent_vocabulary.important: These intents describe capabilities that 3webs may observe on another domain or agent. Their inclusion does not mean that 3webs itself performs these actions.

intents.name: Discover agent
intents.human_request: Find an agent that can compare flights.
intents.expected_machine_behavior: Discover one or more agents whose declared or verified capabilities match the requested task.
intents.example_response: Found FlightSearch, an agent declaring flight search and comparison capabilities.

intents.name: Check agent capability
intents.expected_machine_behavior: Inspect the agent's declared capability, applicable policy, constraints, reachability and confirmation requirements.
intents.example_response: The agent declares reservation capability and requires human confirmation before execution.

intents.name: Delegate task
intents.human_request: Send the hotel search to the specialized agent.
intents.expected_machine_behavior: Delegate a defined task to another compatible agent and return a task identifier or execution state.

intents.name: Orchestrate agents
intents.expected_machine_behavior: Coordinate multiple agents or capabilities toward a shared higher-level objective.
intents.example_response: Coordinating flight, accommodation and local transport capabilities.

intents.name: Parallelize tasks
intents.human_request: Search for the flight, hotel and transfer simultaneously.
intents.expected_machine_behavior: Create independent subtasks that may execute concurrently.
intents.example_response: Three independent subtasks were created for parallel execution.

intents.name: Plan and execute
intents.human_request: Plan and execute the equipment purchase.
intents.expected_machine_behavior: Create an execution plan, identify approval boundaries and execute only actions permitted by policy.
intents.example_response: The plan is prepared. Purchase execution requires human approval.

intents.name: Request quote
intents.expected_machine_behavior: Request structured commercial proposals from compatible providers or agents.
intents.example_response: Three quote requests were submitted; two responses have been received.

intents.name: Negotiate
intents.human_request: Try to obtain a better price.
intents.expected_machine_behavior: Conduct negotiation within explicitly declared authority, policy and economic boundaries.
intents.example_response: A 10% discount was requested; the provider countered with 5%.

intents.name: Validate result
intents.human_request: Verify the result received from the agent.
intents.expected_machine_behavior: Evaluate the returned result against available evidence, provenance, constraints or independent sources.
intents.example_response: The result was validated against available evidence; two independent sources support the principal claims.

intents.name: Request human intervention
intents.human_request: Ask for my approval before payment.
intents.expected_machine_behavior: Pause execution at a defined human-oversight boundary and request explicit authorization.
intents.example_response: Human approval is required before the payment can proceed.

intents.name: Resume task
intents.expected_machine_behavior: Resume an existing task from a recoverable execution state.
intents.example_response: The task resumed from the last confirmed execution state.

intents.name: Cancel task
intents.expected_machine_behavior: Request cancellation of an active task and propagate cancellation to delegated agents where supported.
intents.example_response: Cancellation requested. Delegated agents will stop where cancellation is supported.

intents.name: Get task status
intents.human_request: What is the status of the task?
intents.expected_machine_behavior: Return the current machine-readable execution state of a task.
intents.example_response: Status: working. The accommodation capability is checking availability.

intents.name: Share artifact
intents.human_request: Send the report to the financial agent.
intents.expected_machine_behavior: Transfer or reference a task artifact to another authorized agent while preserving applicable metadata and provenance.
intents.example_response: The report artifact was made available to the authorized financial agent.

intents.name: Audit agent activity
intents.human_request: Show me which agents were used and what they did.
intents.expected_machine_behavior: Return available execution history, participating agents, actions, artifacts, evidence and provenance information.
intents.example_response: Three agents participated. Available task history identifies their actions, artifacts and evidence.

intent_resolution.strategy: Match the caller's requested outcome to the most specific supported service intent or recognized Machine Web intent.
intent_resolution.ambiguity: If required parameters cannot be inferred reliably, request the missing parameter rather than inventing it.
intent_resolution.unknown_intent: Return unsupported_intent and, where possible, identify the closest recognized intents.

machine_web_evaluation.principle: Declaration is not proof of operational capability.

states.description: The intent or capability is publicly declared.
The declaration is syntactically and structurally valid.
The declared machine interface can be reached.
The capability exposes an interface that can be invoked under its declared contract.
Observed execution evidence supports the claimed capability.

not_supported.description: Issuing a legal or regulatory compliance certification.
Guaranteeing ranking, indexing, citation, recommendation or inclusion by a search or AI system.
Accessing authenticated, restricted or private areas of a website without explicit supported authorization.
Bypassing authentication, technical access controls or crawler exclusions.
Analysing a website for the purpose of constructing a case against a private natural person.
Inventing or estimating private analytics, Search Console data, traffic, conversion or engagement metrics when they are not observable.
